Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the details. Quick summary after an initial check:
- Brazil requires passports to be valid for at least the duration of stay; however, many carriers and some consulates recommend 6 months beyond departure. Given your June travel window, Laura (exp 2026-12-02) will need to renew. Jonas (exp 2027-06-30) is borderline depending on airline checks—we recommend renewal to avoid issues. Vivek is fine.
- Embassy/Consulate availability: London and New York consulates currently show limited biometric/visa slots. We pulled tentative slots and are seeing short windows Jun 1-4 for express handling (screenshot attached: appointment-slots-screenshot.png).
- Passport renewal courier: standard renewal turnaround (UK/US) is ~3–5 weeks; expedited express renewal + courier is typically 5–7 business days if an appointment and expedited service are secured.
- Invitation letter: attached an editable template (invitation_letter_template.docx). We can populate personalized letters for each exec once you confirm names/titles and hosting contact at Sapphire.

Next steps we propose:
1) Confirm whether Redwood will cover expedited renewal fees (typical range $200–$450 per person, incl. courier).
2) Approve us to lock provisional appointment slots (non-refundable hold) for Jun 1–4 if you want express processing.
3) Provide the hosting contact at Sapphire to personalize letters (name, company address).

We can also coordinate with local consulate liaison if the Sapphire team wants to expedite.

Regards,
Nina Patel
Operations Lead, Horizon Travel
ops@horizon-travel.com
